analysis.label: Modelled seafloor area below the operational hypoxia threshold
analysis.sampling: Every monthly mean from September 1993 through September 2025; plotted comparison uses September only.
analysis.areaMethod: Exact spherical area of each native rectilinear lon/lat cell; missing cells excluded.
analysis.rollingMean: Trailing five-year arithmetic mean of September values only; omitted until five complete Septembers are available.
limitations: This is a model reanalysis, not an in-situ observation.
Copernicus reports a positive dissolved-oxygen bias in deep basins, where anoxia is not reproduced everywhere.
The animation shows variability and evolution; it does not attribute individual years to a single driver.
